description: Join Cynthia Curtin for a St. Patrick’s Day campaign event at Mavis Winkle’s Irish Pub to celebrate community, conversation, and shared values. Enjoy light refreshments, meet-and-greet time with Cynthia, and a brief remarks about her commitment to fair, experienced leadership for Ohio’s 9th District
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Cynthia Curtin for Judge Committee
title: Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day — Cynthia Curtin for Judge
